text: Bitcoin's 6.7% gain and dominance at 58.9% show capital flowing toward the largest asset, while Ethereum's smaller 5% move suggests secondary assets are lagging the rally. The Fear & Greed index at 70 reflects sustained optimism with a sharp 13-point weekly climb, yet the $158B volume remains moderate relative to BTC's size, indicating momentum is real but not yet capitulation-driven buying.
